@phoneContactsSearchHint.description: Placeholder of the search field on the Contacts tab; typing filters by name, note or address

@phoneContactsAtoZ.description: Link and heading on the Contacts tab: lists the contacts alphabetically instead of by latest payment

@phoneContactsNoPayments.description: State line of a contact's row when nothing was paid to or by them yet

@phoneContactsAsks.description: State line of a contact's row when they sent an invoice that waits for the user. {amount} is the amount with the unit, e.g. 42.5 EPIC

@phoneContactsFaces.description: Screen reader label of the strip of contact faces above the list on the Contacts tab

phoneContactPaired: Paired · payments between you are sealed

@phoneContactPaired.description: Line under a paired contact's name on its page; shown only when the pairing is active

@phoneContactRequest.description: Button at the bottom of a contact's page that opens the form to ask this contact for an amount. One word.
